summary: Vertical Aerospace filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 16, 2026 its wholly owned subsidiary, Vertical Aerospace Group Limited, entered into a Marketing Services Agreement with Outside The Box Capital Inc. for investor-relations-style marketing and distribution services through social media and online channels. The term runs September 16, 2026 to March 15, 2027, for an undisclosed cash fee. The filing includes the customary Form F-3 incorporation-by-reference language and is signed by CEO Stuart Simpson. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or closing condition is stated; watch only for disclosure of the fee or related promotional activity.
